method.rollback: Revert the bounded UTF-8 primitive implementation commits; no persisted format, migration, or user data depends on this Grain.
method.review_separation: An independent semantic reviewer must review the exact implementation head, byte-bound semantics, no-truncation behavior, Debug redaction, and required evidence separately from the implementing agent before acceptance.
method.control: Implementation is limited to one dependency-free bounded UTF-8 value/error module, focused tests, and morize-core re-exports. No field-specific limits, normalization, serde, persistence, collections, timestamps, or domain behavior is authorized.

outcome: morize-core exposes a dependency-free BoundedUtf8<const MAX_BYTES: usize> value that enforces a hard UTF-8 byte ceiling without truncation or normalization, provides deterministic value semantics, and avoids exposing contained text through Debug.
rationale: P1 explicitly requires bounded strings, and DATA_MODEL serialization invariants require bounded field sizes. This Grain adds only the reusable in-memory UTF-8 byte-bound primitive; field-specific limits, normalization rules, persistence, serialization, collections, timestamps, and domain records remain separate decisions.
title: Add bounded UTF-8 text primitive
